title: land warns of no work rows for an item whose only window is a branch row
goal: Found in the SP-mlemdqbn review (TK-nwxefymo): bl_land.py, where land warns that an item has no work rows, accepts only ql_capture.WORK_ACTIONS (claim, done, release), so a headless worker item whose window opened from a branch row (ql_capture.OPEN_ACTIONS) and has no cost line yet is warned about although its work was captured. The test takes OPEN_ACTIONS as well.

run: import pathlib,sys;L=[l for l in pathlib.Path("_tools/bl_land.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if "ql_capture.WORK_ACTIONS" in l];print(L);sys.exit(0 if L and all("OPEN_ACTIONS" in l for l in L) else 1)
